headline: China Alumina Production Drops 3.3% in October to 8.12 Million Tons
summary: Chinese alumina output declined 3.3% month-over-month to 8.12 million metric tons in October, down from September's record high as refinery margins narrowed amid domestic market oversupply.
why: China is the world's largest producer and consumer of alumina, the raw material used to produce primary aluminum.

impacts.name: Alumina
impacts.why: China's monthly alumina output dropped 3.3% to 8.12 million tons in October.
